tests.title: Tests
tests.description: Replay past conversations against your AI agent before it talks to customers. Replies are never sent, actions that change data are simulated, and test runs are never billed.
tests.allowance: {remaining} of {limit} free test replies left this month

draft.title: Testing a playbook draft
draft.description: Replies use the draft of {name}, not the published version.

replay.title: Replay past conversations
replay.description: Each shopper message is answered once by the AI, with the real history up to that point. The AI's reply is compared with what your team actually sent.
replay.maxTurns: Shopper messages to replay per conversation
replay.label: Name (optional)
replay.noTranscripts: No imported conversations yet. Import some from another tool first.
replay.selectedTranscripts: No conversations selected | {count} conversation selected | {count} conversations selected

import.title: Import past conversations
import.description: Paste conversations or upload an export from another tool. They are kept for your organization's retention period and only used for tests.
import.contentPlaceholder:
Customer: Where is my order?
Agent: Can I have the order number?
import.businessName: Your name in the WhatsApp chat
import.gorgiasHelp: The email and API key are used for this import only and are not stored.
import.done: No conversations imported | Imported {count} conversation | Imported {count} conversations

report.title: Test report
report.estimated: Estimated from {count} replayed shopper messages. A sample of past conversations shows what to fix; it does not predict an exact rate.
report.notJudged: {count} could not be answered or judged.
report.agreement: Compared with what your team sent: {same} same answer, {partial} partly the same, {different} different.
report.noHumanReply: The shopper had the last word
report.storeDataChanged: Store data changed since: the AI read today's orders and stock, not what was true back then.

bucketHelp.answered: The AI answered on its own.
bucketHelp.handed_off: The AI passed the conversation to your team.
bucketHelp.needed_action: The AI would have changed something in your store. The call was simulated.
bucketHelp.wrong_or_risky: Fix these first: wrong facts, risky promises, or a claim no action backs.
bucketHelp.knowledge_missing: The AI lacked store information. Add it to your knowledge or playbook.
